name: chalid
description: Chalid Astrakein, the sun prophet: a tanned man with dark hair and a full dark beard, a radiant golden crown of sun rays, flowing white robes under a wide gold-trimmed golden mantle with long hanging sleeves, a glowing golden sun emblem on the chest, a golden belt, brown sandals, his RIGHT hand raised palm-out in blessing, and a tall golden staff topped by a blazing golden sun in his LEFT hand
hands: the sun staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty open hand (raised palm-out in blessing at rest)

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, the sun-ray crown tilting, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the sun staff arm thrown up and out to the right, the empty right hand flung out to the left)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent under the white robes, the sun staff dipping, the empty right hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-right, body thrown back, the sun staff arm flung up, the empty right hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward under the white robes, torso slumps forward, head droops, the sun staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the sun staff tilted down with its golden sun resting on the ground at the lower-left, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the sun staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, the sun-ray crown still on his head; the sun staff lies on the ground at the lower-left; the golden mantle spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the golden mantle settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the sun on his staff dimmed, the sun staff on the ground beside him
